import io

def sum_numbers(text):
    f = io.StringIO(text)          # an in-memory 'file' you can iterate
    total = 0
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        total += int(line)
    return total

# --- demo (do not change) ---
data = "10\n\n20\n  \n30\n"
print(sum_numbers(data))

assert sum_numbers("10\n\n20\n  \n30\n") == 60
assert sum_numbers("") == 0
assert sum_numbers("5") == 5
assert sum_numbers("1\n2\n3\n") == 6
assert sum_numbers("\n\n\n") == 0
assert sum_numbers("  7  \n\n  3\n") == 10
assert sum_numbers("42\n") == 42
